segments.text:
V. 43.
And if a Perſon cauſe thee to offend—(The Diſcourſe paſſes from the Caſe of offending, to that of being offended) if one who is as uſeful or dear to thee as an hand or eye, hinder or ſlacken thee in the Ways of GOD, renounce all Intercourſe with him. This primarily relates to Perſons, ſecondarily to Things.
